capabilities: Render Markdown headings and lists as an editable mindmap
Edit node text inline with keyboard shortcuts
Create child and sibling nodes from the map
Reorder and re-parent branches with drag and drop
Configure layout, spacing, colors, and node width
extras: Settings are global and stored in the plugin's data.json rather than per-note frontmatter; mobile gets a touch-specific action rail.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit an ordinary note's heading and list structure as an interactive mindmap.
summary: Editable mindmap view that renders a Markdown note's headings and lists as nodes that can be edited, formatted, and rearranged directly.
